description: AdvanVis - Smart Rose, Pie and Donut puts a Nightingale rose, pie and donut chart in one Power BI visual, and explains your data in plain English. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • Rose by area or radius, pie and donut, on a full circle, semicircle, 270 degrees or a custom arc • Top N with a working Other slice: hover Other to see what it contains • Highest and lowest highlighting, colour rules by value, percentage or rank, and fx conditional formatting • Report theme colours, a colour-blind safe scheme and vector pattern fills • Image slices from a column of images stored in your data • Centre value with your own unit or currency, and an optional logo uploaded from your computer • Show condition: hide the chart when a 0/1 measure is 0 • Basic headline, tooltips, drill-down, cross-filtering, keyboard navigation and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource) • Smart insights: a headline and findings on leaders, contributors, targets, concentration, outliers, reliance and growth • How calculated: hover or Tab to any finding to see the numbers behind it • Change against last period: growth and share change, as amounts and points • Targets and budgets scored met or missed • Design tips while editing HOW THE INSIGHTS WORK Smart insights are worked out inside the visual by built-in…
